_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of orders, including customer history tracking, order line item management, and order processing.

cust_hist._description: Tracks historical customer purchases, linking each transaction to a specific customer and product.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the customer entity

orderlines._description: Tracks individual product quantities and associated orders in the DellStore2 sales process.

columns.name: orderlineid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orderlines

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orderlines

columns.name: prod_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the prod_ entity

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stores the number of items for each product line in an order.

columns.name: orderdate
columns.description: Stores the date format of order placement (YYYY-MM-DD) in a consistent manner.

orders._description: Tracks details of individual customer orders and their associated financial information in DellStore2.

columns.name: orderid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in orders

columns.name: orderdate
columns.description: Stores formatted date strings for order placement in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the customer entity

columns.name: netamount
columns.description: Stores the total floating-point value of items ordered in each transaction.

columns.name: tax
columns.description: Stores floating-point values representing taxes for individual orders.

columns.name: totalamount
columns.description: Stores the total monetary value (in decimal format) for each order.
